overview: FlashCart is a high-traffic production e-commerce marketplace preparing for its Mega Shopping Festival. Thousands of customers concurrently browse, search, reserve items, and checkout flash sale products. Eight production incidents have surfaced that must be diagnosed and resolved.
bug_topics: Stale Search Responses and Request Sequencing
Concurrent Inventory Overselling and Atomic Locks
Duplicate Payment Transactions and Settlement State
Binary Max-Heap Product Ranking and Priority Queue
Payment Gateway Verification and State Confirmation

incidents.title: Duplicate Checkout Requests
incidents.symptoms: Rapid successive clicks or slow network submissions result in multiple order records and double charges for the same checkout attempt.
incidents.expected: Only one order should be created per checkout attempt.

incidents.title: Stale Product Search Responses
incidents.symptoms: When quickly typing or modifying search queries, older responses can arrive after newer ones and overwrite the visible product results.
incidents.expected: Only the results from the most recent search query should be displayed.

incidents.title: Concurrent Inventory Overselling
incidents.symptoms: When a limited quantity item is purchased concurrently, multiple checkouts succeed and stock falls into invalid counts.
incidents.expected: Stock reservations must be atomic and prevent overselling beyond actual availability.

incidents.title: Duplicate Payment Transactions
incidents.symptoms: Retrying payment on timeout or re-submitting payment creates multiple successful payment transactions on the same order.
incidents.expected: Payment transactions must be idempotent and prevent multiple successful settlements for an order.

incidents.title: Incorrect Product Ranking Heap
incidents.symptoms: Trending products on the storefront do not appear in the intended order, especially when products have equal or close popularity scores.
incidents.expected: Products must strictly follow the priority queue ranking criteria with deterministic tie-breaking.

incidents.title: Incorrect Combined Filters and Pagination
incidents.symptoms: Applying multiple category, brand, and price filters leads to missing items across paginated pages.
incidents.expected: Pagination must accurately navigate across the entire filtered dataset without omissions.

incidents.title: False Payment Success Screen
incidents.symptoms: Navigating to the payment callback URL displays a confirmation screen even if the backend payment was not settled.
incidents.expected: Success screens must only be shown after verifying payment status with the backend API.

incidents.title: Incorrect Warehouse Inventory Allocation
incidents.symptoms: Orders allocating items across multiple regional warehouses fail or allocate from warehouses whose inventory is already reserved.
incidents.expected: Fulfillment must allocate from warehouses respecting priority order and subtracting existing reservations.
